plan: Reduce QQQI to 20% to lower concentration and preserve capital.
Exit all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to eliminate high risk.
Sell semiconductor holdings (SMH, MUU) to reduce sector concentration.

conservative.read: This plan prioritizes capital preservation, aiming for lower, steadier returns. Expect modest gains with significantly reduced drawdown potential. The large cash buffer provides safety but dampens upside.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to balance income and concentration.
Reduce leveraged ETFs (SOXL to 3%, SPAL to 1%) to lower risk.
Sell semiconductor holdings (SMH, MUU) to reduce sector concentration.
Sell leveraged AI/Software ETFs (METU, PLTU) to cut risk.

balanced.read: This balanced approach seeks risk-first growth by trimming leverage and diversifying. Expect moderate returns with controlled drawdowns. The addition of XLF provides some defensive balance.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to manage concentration while keeping some income.
Increase leveraged ETFs (SOXL to 6%, SPAL to 6%) to amplify potential gains.
Sell semiconductor holdings (SMH, MUU) to reduce sector concentration.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for maximum growth by increasing leverage and concentrating on strong setups. Expect higher potential returns but also significantly larger drawdowns and the risk of rapid losses. Leveraged ETF decay is a key risk.

plan: Increase QQQI to 30% to maximize focus on income generation.
Exit all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to eliminate high risk.
